title: festuca ovina subsp. caesia
intro: Festuca ovina subsp. caesia, commonly known as blue sheep's fleece or blue fescue, is a subspecies of Festuca ovina, a type of grass native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of blue sheep's fleece include promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety, and improving sleep quality, attributed to its sedative and calming effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
